description: Room Data Access Object (DAO) interface for Note entity, providing methods for database operations such as retrieval, search, insertion, update, and deletion.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Room DAO interface with methods to perform CRUD and query operations on Note entities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last updated date, returning LiveData that updates in real-time.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches notes by title or content matching the provided query, ordered by last updated date.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note or replaces existing one on conflict, returning the inserted row ID.
